chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn, from Ibn Muskān, from Al-Ḥalabī, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “At times I would stand and perform salat (prayer) while in front of me there was a cushion containing images of birds, so I would place a cloth over it.”

key_terms.تَمَاثِيلُ: figures or images depicted on an object
key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a cloth used to cover the object
key_terms.ٱلْوِسَادَةُ: a cushion or pillow placed nearby

ai.seo_question: What should be done if there are images in front of a person during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates a practical ruling related to salat (prayer) in the presence of depicted forms. It shows that covering a cushion bearing images of birds was done so that the salat (prayer) could be performed appropriately.
